title: Static Broad Open-Jaw Hippopotamus
description: One complete newly authored stylised hippopotamus-like animal in a fixed open-mouth stance: a broad low barrel torso flows through a short thick neck into a huge raised rounded upper muzzle. One whole deep lower jaw slopes from a seated rear root into a broad low lip, leaving a genuine wide air gap and visible dark oral roof/floor between the jaws. Two thick blunt lower canine-like teeth sit on that jaw. Four short thick legs with broad finite feet, small high ears and eyes, paired nasal mounds and a short tapering tail complete the animal. All body sections, jaw and limbs new, not a rhinoceros with horns removed or a pig resized; no imported parts. One static opaque animal, zero scenes.
